Welcome To Steve's Music Center ! 845-796-3616 Home About Steve's Return Policy Jazzmosis Contact Us Repairs Search Log in 0 items Check out Baroni Lab GD Drive Baroni Lab Default Title - $189.00 Despite its calm and cool exterior, the GD Drive is not the kind of pedal to take lightly. Finding its place somewhere between overdrive and distortion, the GD Drive uses specially selected germanium components which are matched and placed in the optimum position within it’s circuit to provide a sweet, creamy distortion thick with natural paired harmonics. The result is a drive which sounds great with both single coils and humbuckers. Baroni Lab GD Drive The GD Drive has a classic tone in every sense of the word. Versatility is a key element of this stomp box, with the tone ranging from softer boost drive to fully saturated lead tones which sustain and swell into a natural harmonic feedback. If classic rock and germanium overdrive is your thing, you can’t go wrong with the GD Drive. Controls: Drive, Tone, Volume, Bypass footswitch Power Supply: 12V DC Power Adapter Dimensions: 106(W) x 42/32(H:Top/Bottom) x 131(D) mm Demo Link https://soundcloud.com/user-127254833/germanium-drive-baroni-lab-stompbox-pedals-demo-4 https://soundcloud.com/user-127254833/germanium-drive-baroni-lab-stompbox-pedals-demo-3 https://soundcloud.com/user-127254833/germanium-drive-baroni-lab-stompbox-pedals-demo-2 https://soundcloud.com/user-127254833/germanium-drive-baroni-lab-stompbox-pedals-demo-1 Please Note: Our pedals only work with 12V. From compression/sustain through light overdrive and heavy distortion to modulation and delay, we have everything you need to embellish and improve the sound of your guitar rig. Baroni Lab effects are 100% hand-crafted by a small, dedicated team of in-house professionals, using only the highest quality components sourced from the best suppliers world-wide. All of the Baroni Lab pedals require a 12v DC power supply for correct operation. We do not currently include a power supply with the purchase of any pedals. This can be purchased separately from our Accessories section of the website however most 12v DC power supplies should work fine. The tube preamp pedals require 500mA-1A of power for best results.
